description: This file contains unit tests for the BuzzDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the Buzz module. It includes setup methods and multiple test cases validating CRUD operations, data retrieval, and relationships for buzz posts, shares, photos, videos, and comments.

classes.name: BuzzDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the functionality of the BuzzDao class in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It extends KernelTestCase to facilitate integration testing with database setup, and uses traits for ORM helper methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Buzz feed posts with specified filters and validates the structure and content of posts.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of Buzz feed posts based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Checks retrieval of photo IDs associated with a post ID, including cases with no photos and non-existing posts.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPost
methods.description: Tests saving a new BuzzPost, including setting timestamps and employee associations.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzShare
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzShare linked to a BuzzPost, including setting various properties and timestamps.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Tests saving a video link associated with a BuzzPost.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPhotos
methods.description: Tests saving photos for a BuzzPost, including verifying photo data and metadata.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost1
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzPost and verifies related data is cleaned up.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost2
methods.description: Tests deletion of another BuzzPost and its associated photos and shares.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost3
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzPost with linked videos, ensuring cascading deletion.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Tests deletion of a BuzzShare and validates associated changes.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare2
methods.description: Further tests delete share scenarios with linked data.

methods.name: testGetBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a BuzzShare by Its post ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList1
methods.description: Validates listing of shares for a specific post.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList2
methods.description: Validates listing with no shares (edge case).

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount1
methods.description: Checks count of shares for a specific post.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount2
methods.description: Checks count when no shares exist for a post.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by share and comment IDs, validating contents.

methods.name: testGetBuzzComments
methods.description: Retrieves comments for a specific share.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of comments on a share.
